venues.note: Tour Gary's shop/studio to see what's brewing for Halloween this year.
Featuring affordable giclée prints from a variety of our favorite artists. Take an insider tour of our screen printing shop and darkroom, while enjoying Dr. Banzai's spinning vinyl.
A creative studio specializing in printmaking and art production, known for high-quality, limited-edition screenprints sought after by collectors and enthusiasts alike.

FRIPP jewelry, video art. Request for material: help artists Yustina Salnikova and Joel Stockdill with their public sculpture for the SF Zoo by bringing your old broken cords — charging cables, aux, electric, speaker wire, etc.

We're doing something new! Featuring the original artwork of Shannon Carleen Knight, a self-taught Eugene artist whose vibrant, richly layered acrylic paintings combine bold color and collage. Come see her work, grab some coffee, play in the arcade, color, watch cartoons and hang out with us during Art Hop. Lola's Mahal will be here 11-4 with Filipino and Soul food fusions. First exhibition — first of many, maybe?

The Parking Meter Art show opens in the Main Gallery, featuring 180 artworks that 40 artists created for the Eugene Parking Meter Art Project. All pieces priced at $30! Guest Artist Richard Quigley shows his surrealist paintings and 3D creations, with a 2pm guest artist talk.

Wellington Drive: Drawing on Crosby, Stills & Nash, The Beatles, and Simon & Garfunkel for inspiration, Wellington Drive fully delivers in 3-part harmonies, subtle and sparkling keyboards and guitars, and exciting arrangements of original songs and loved classics.
Free snacks and beverages, live glassblowing, $50 blow your own pumpkin special.

We are a group of three individuals coming together to celebrate art, creation, and woodworking. We do photography, digital art, costumes, jewelry, games, furniture, and larger projects more closely related to construction. Come see our wares and costumes!
Visit the ETC gallery to see the annual Eugene Weavers' Guild Open Show! Featuring handwoven art from local guild members.

Featuring 3 different artists: Josh Thornley — mixed media & wooden art utilizing up-cycled materials; John of Alejandro Leather — fine handmade leather goods; Eep — illuminated objects made with metal, fire and electricity. Wine and chocolate provided!
